summary: Frontend-only validation of 4 new features layered on top of the iter1 pill-scaling + iframe-embed work: (1) QR code 'Preview on Phone' button in AHU/VAV modals; (2) productionized mobile_mockup.html with live /api/data fetch; (3) /mobile React redirect route; (4) ASHRAE 90.1 + Guideline 36 reference docs. Six of seven scenarios fully pass. ONE real bug found: the /mobile/:kind/:id React route does not propagate the URL params into the redirect hash — /mobile/ahu/AHU-01 currently redirects to /mobile_mockup.html (no hash) instead of /mobile_mockup.html#/ahu/AHU-01, so the mobile detail view fails to auto-open. Also a happy regression confirmation: the iter1 iframe-mode CSS leak (G36 timeline strip visible in iframe-mode dashboard) is now FIXED — clean screenshot at 360x640 ?iframe=1.

ui_bugs.issue: /mobile/:kind/:id route discards :kind and :id. Mobile.jsx useEffect builds the redirect as `/mobile_mockup.html + (window.location.hash||'')`, but with a path-based URL like /mobile/ahu/AHU-01 there is NO hash on the browser URL — kind/id live in pathname params. Result: navigating to /mobile/ahu/AHU-01 redirects to /mobile_mockup.html with empty hash, so the mobile page lands on Site Overview instead of the AHU-01 detail view. Verified live: pathname=/mobile_mockup.html, hash='', vavList rows=0. The QR code feature itself emits the correct deep-link URL (#/ahu/AHU-01 directly into mobile_mockup.html), so QR-scan path works. The bug only bites if someone hits /mobile/ahu/<id> via the React route (which IS registered in App.js line 34).

action_items: Fix /app/frontend/src/pages/Mobile.jsx: import useParams from react-router-dom, capture { kind, id }, and build the redirect target as `/mobile_mockup.html` + (kind && id ? `#/${kind}/${id}` : (window.location.hash || '')). After fix, /mobile/ahu/AHU-01 should land on /mobile_mockup.html#/ahu/AHU-01 and render the AHU detail view (vavList rows > 0).
No other action items — all 6 remaining scenarios pass cleanly. iter1 G36 leak is fixed.
critical_code_review_comments: Mobile.jsx forwards only window.location.hash, not react-router params — root cause of the only failing scenario. Two-line fix.
dashboard.html is now 5765 lines. Still over the 700-line guideline. Carry-over from iter1.

QR overlay (#r5-qr-overlay) uses class 'show' for visibility — clean, no z-index conflicts observed. Escape + backdrop-click both close correctly. Copy URL writes to clipboard AND temporarily flips button text to 'Copied!' — both behaviours verified live.
iframe-mode hides QR button via computed-style display:none (verified). Good chrome scoping vs iter1 leak.

Mobile mockup fetchLive() correctly replaces the DEMO_AHUs fallback with /api/data response — AHU-01..AHU-05 verified live, 58 total VAVs confirmed, tap on AHU-05 → #/ahu/AHU-05 → 10 vavList rows. Live-data wiring is solid.

Parity md5 across /app/frontend/public, /app/archive/Red5-AHU-V1.9, /app/archive/Red5-AHU-V2.0 is IDENTICAL for dashboard.html (270be903ebdb4b1f32f80e994ec9a909), mobile_mockup.html (14bfe0fd7e0258c3e399789220b0c0c9), js/docs_index.js (f6fc9657e0f9288f30cfc5da5b73290f), js/qrcode.min.js (170c5297533897f4793f676fd2d259d6). Perfect parity.

Docs panel (window.red5DocsIndex.open() invoked by [data-testid='standards-btn']) now lists both new entries — '⚡ ASHRAE 90.1 Energy Reference' and '🎯 ASHRAE Guideline 36' — confirmed visible in the standards drawer alongside the existing G36 Cross-Walk, Band Guide, ASHRAE 55, etc.
Both reference docs return HTTP 200 with substantial content: ashrae_90_1_reference.md = 8236 bytes, ashrae_g36_reference.md = 10095 bytes (both > 1000 chars threshold).

rca of the issue.bug: /mobile/:kind/:id React route does not propagate URL params into the mobile_mockup.html hash; user lands on Site Overview instead of the AHU/VAV detail view.
rca of the issue.reproduce: 1) Hit https://controller-dashboard-2.preview.emergentagent.com/mobile/ahu/AHU-01 at 420x900. 2) Wait ~4s for redirect. 3) Observe: window.location.pathname === '/mobile_mockup.html', window.location.hash === '' (empty), and document.querySelectorAll('#vavList .list-row').length === 0 — the AHU detail page didn't render because the hash route is missing.
rca of the issue.rca: /app/frontend/src/pages/Mobile.jsx line 18: `const target = '/mobile_mockup.html' + (window.location.hash || '');`. When the route is /mobile/ahu/AHU-01, `kind` and `id` are URL pathname params (react-router useParams), NOT a hash on window.location. So the concatenation appends empty string and the deep-link is lost. App.js correctly registers `<Route path='/mobile/:kind/:id' element={<Mobile/>}/>` at line 34 so Mobile.jsx receives the navigation — it just doesn't read the params.

verified_observations.iter1_g36_leak_status: FIXED — clean screenshot at /dashboard.html?iframe=1&modal_ahu=AHU-01 360x640, no dark G36 timeline panel visible.
